milestone: Reviewed damaged checklist identity recovery and lossless legacy text conversion
status: Implemented within current recovery/native scope; wider rank3 and Px remain incomplete

behavior.review: Missing/null/empty/malformed/oversized/control-character and duplicated child references require explicit review; all occurrences of duplicate references are regenerated. Unique valid legacy identities remain unchanged. Raw strings become named open subtasks after explicit review.
behavior.preservation: Object fields other than affected id values, order, nesting, completion, notes, scheduling, assignments, labels, discussions, attachments and unknown metadata preserved. No guessed title or partial salvage of unknown structures.
behavior.save: Prepare is cancellable/off-main-actor. Review/Apply has no task write. Source/task/workspace guards before apply/save. iOS organizer Save updates parent draft and parent Save persists; Mac uses existing inspector save/Undo. Original data is bounded literal JSON with explicit system Share action.
behavior.bounds: 10000 checklist nodes,32 total child levels including base depth,100000 JSON values,128 JSON levels,2.1MB encoded original AND proposed data; full TaskHierarchyIndex/reference-storage validation. UUID allocation reserves all existing valid references and has64 retries. Refusal returns no partial proposed tree.
behavior.inlineSafety: Legacy raw strings remain readable and non-object inline edits are disabled. Adding refuses an unknown non-list container, including keyboard handler. Mac child read/replacement refuses duplicate and positional collisions/unknown nodes; inspector enabled-state lookup is linear for the complete sibling list.
behavior.contracts: No new backend, task schema, shared table/field, permission, file type, sibling build dependency or notification/cache format. Existing standard subtask IDs/objects and durable Store mutations are used. General older-client rollout remains deferred; no selected previous reader rerun claimed.

scope: Every duplicate occurrence rekeyed across nesting; all non-ID fields and ordering preserved
Raw string conversion and full original JSON roundtrip
Whole-review refusal for unknown node/title/children/root formats
Cancelled/changed-source review cannot apply; worker cancellation yields no partial proposal
Allocator collision with any saved identity and invalid/repeated allocator refusal
Depth/base-depth, payload,nonfinite values and item limits refuse without truncation
Recovered complete hierarchy/filter shape valid; old ambiguous child route absent
Actual Snapshot mutation/serialization and reversal preserve exact original damaged tree
Inline/root-container safety; matching Mac single/bulk path primitives reject ambiguity
Expanded legacy output must fit its next organizer opening

native.scope: Exact isolated iPhone/iPad local fixtures. Review/Original viewing/Apply/Cancel preserve saved root; organizer Save still only edits parent draft; parent Save changes only recovered subtree content/IDs within tested fields. Actual saved JSON proves5 unique IDs with stable ID preserved, original duplicates absent, semantic non-ID content equal including converted strings. Normal relaunch no longer offers recovery. Unknown nested structures retain exact cache bytes on cancel; Save remains disabled. Existing organizer Cancel/move/save/relaunch regression passes on phone. iPad recovery full flow uses largest accessibility text and dark appearance; unknown refusal case uses default light.
native.sourceProgression: Phone includes asynchronous preparation and inline/path safeguards. Tablet adds final proposed-output bound and test-only scrolling of virtualized static text. A later bulk lookup helper is used only by Mac inspector; final Core suites and Mac build compile/test it. iOS tested recovery behavior is unchanged by that unused helper.
native.limits: Native Save failure, real concurrent/cloud/workspace-switch walkthroughs, Share destination/upload, spoken VoiceOver and real Mac app interaction were not exercised for this milestone. Primitive Snapshot reversal is not a claim of a new full native Undo walkthrough.

macBuild.scope: Current isolated Mac app/extensions compile. Computer-use recheck reports Mac locked; no unlock request or live Mac UI acceptance claimed.

macComponent.dataModel: Read-only review values fixture; Core/Store not loaded by renderer
macComponent.scope: Production component offscreen AppKit light/dark layout, default native tint, no account/credentials/input or mutation.

initialPhone.scope: Superseded synchronous preparation version; not counted in retained5.

firstTablet.reason: Largest-text review summary was below native visible/virtualized area. UI hierarchy confirms review/body present; test now scrolls until static text exists and scrolls upward to draft notice. Product font size unchanged.

firstCore.reason: Generic JSON depth64 rejected supported32-level checklist with opaque nested metadata. Raised generic bound128, retaining actual checklist depth32; final nesting test passes.

visualReview: Phone review/refusal, iPad largest dark review and relaunch, Mac light/dark components inspected. Natural scroll viewports may cut content at an edge; no claim all text/rows fit one screen. Captures contain synthetic work only.

installations.status: removed exact unsigned isolated Mac product

cleanup.preserved: Current accepted results, all logs/summaries, selected failure hierarchy, final captures/source and reusable build caches. Real accounts, task data, app installations and system-managed widget processes untouched.

remaining: Unfamiliar future formats remain preserved/read-only; no automatic guessing or partial salvage. Oversized data remains in original task/backup.
Live Mac interaction/Undo, spoken accessibility, paired cloud/offline concurrency, wider localization and independent-child-record/headings contracts remain open.
Location physical permission/region/delivery/callback and private desktop-to-phone authoring, other remaining ranks and full Px remain incomplete.
